title: Max Klare would give the Broncos a big-play threat at TE

sources.title: Max Klare would give the Broncos a big-play threat at TE
sources.description: One prospect who may interest the Denver Broncos in the second round of the 2026 NFL Draft is former Ohio State tight end Max Klare. He is a 6-4, 246-pound tight end who is expected to be a second-round selection in the upcoming NFL Draft. The Athletic’s lead draft analyst, Dane Brugler, has Klare ranked […]
